title: Asking for a raise
scenario: You've been at the company for two years. You want to ask your manager for a raise because you've taken on more responsibility.
greeting: Hi, you wanted to talk to me?
objectives: State your case clearly and confidently
Mention your achievements and new responsibilities
Propose a specific number (salary or percentage)
Listen to the manager's response and negotiate

vocabulary.example: I'd like to discuss a raise.
My biggest achievement this year was...
I think I deserve a raise.
My performance reviews have been excellent.

fallbackHints: Start with: 'I'd like to discuss my salary.'
Propose: 'I believe a 10% raise is fair.'
aiSystemPrompt: You are a manager. Your direct report is asking for a raise. You respect them, but you have budget constraints. You want to understand their case. Be fair but also realistic. You may offer a smaller raise, a bonus, or other benefits. Be willing to negotiate but have limits. Correct major mistakes gently.
firstTurn: Hi, you said you wanted to chat. Sure, what's on your mind?
